text: This is probably nothing and I feel a bit daft messaging. Grandson is 5, he's had a temperature since yesterday, 38.9 tonight. Earlier he was running about and bumped his head on the corner of the table, cried straight away, big wail, but he's acting completely normal now, back to his usual self, chatting away about his dinosaurs. Breathing fine. I just wasn't sure if the bump and the temperature together means anything or if I'm worrying over nothing.
